heading: Join test evaluation — direct comparison
text:
### Join test evaluation — direct comparison [LNLS.5.6]

Because all join tests have an EQ anchor (LNLS.3.3), the compiler
can generate a specialized direct-comparison function per beta node.
The boolean expression-tree walk (O(E)) for the
equality anchor test is replaced with a single scalar or pointer
comparison at the machine level.  Remaining join tests (range checks
on the same pair) continue to use the expression evaluator but fire
only against that single candidate (O(1) by LNLS.3.3).

The net effect: the equality-anchor portion of every join test
evaluates in O(1), not O(E).
